paragraphs.text: A new shop opened last week. It was on Sugar Street. The shop was small and pink.
paragraphs.translation: 上周，糖果镇新开了一家店。它开在糖果街上。这家小店是粉色的。

paragraphs.text: On Saturday, Lily and her mum walked there. They saw many jars on the wall. The jars were full of sweet candy.
paragraphs.translation: 星期六，莉莉和妈妈走到了那里。她们看到墙上挂着许多罐子。罐子里装满了甜甜的糖果。

paragraphs.text: A tall man was behind the desk. His name was Mr. Sweet. He smiled and said hello to Lily.
paragraphs.translation: 一位高个子男士站在柜台后面。他叫斯威特先生。他微笑着跟莉莉打招呼。

paragraphs.text: Lily looked at all the candy. She wanted a big red lollipop. She had a red lollipop. She ate it on the way home.
paragraphs.translation: 莉莉把所有的糖果都看了一遍。她想要一支大大的红色棒棒糖。她买了一支红色的棒棒糖，回家的路上把它吃掉了。

paragraphs.text: Her mum had some lemon candy too. The lemon candy was sour but nice. They thanked Mr. Sweet and went home.
paragraphs.translation: 她妈妈也买了一些柠檬糖。柠檬糖酸酸的，但很好吃。她们谢过斯威特先生就回家了。

paragraphs.text: The new shop was busy all day. Lily wanted to come back soon.
paragraphs.translation: 这家新店一整天都很热闹。莉莉想早点再来。
